scientific_integrity: Analytical induction with boundary cases; an exact standalone checker enumerates all growth histories through nine leaves and independently checks moment recurrences through 120 leaves. Finite verification is not substituted for proof. Residual historical-priority uncertainty is recorded.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact covariance for the rooted Yule–Harding–Kingman leaf-splitting model with unweighted edge depths; not a PDA law, continuous-time branch-length result or joint limit theorem. The correlation consequence uses the established Yule Sackin variance.
title: Exact cherry–Sackin covariance in Yule phylogenetic trees
